meta.title: Agent browser takeover
meta.description: Adds an "Agent browser" tab to the right sidebar showing this conversation's browser live. Take control to sign in or solve a captcha, then hand it back; the agent's browser tools pause while you drive, and the agent can call browser_request_human to ask for you. Every conversation gets its own browser, so agents in different projects can browse in parallel; each new browser starts with your saved logins, and handing back after signing in saves that login for all later browsers. Requires dsh-agent-browser and dsh-better-sidebar.
